create_maskdata_structure: create a MaskData structure for storing and batch-managing masks with related data
build_point_grid: build a 2D grid of evenly spaced points in [0,1]x[0,1] for a given number of points per side
generate_crop_boxes: generate crop boxes of different sizes for multi-layer image cropping with specified overlap ratio
encode_masks_to_rle: encode binary masks to uncompressed RLE format compatible with pycoco tools
calculate_stability_score: calculate stability score for batched masks using IoU between high and low thresholded masks
